body: Source review follow-up on dbe55346/d91363a2: DocumentSaveSheetWindowProbe captures requestID/workspace only in makeNSView; updateNSView is empty. SwiftUI may reuse the NSView with new representable inputs, leaving capture tied to an old request and never reporting an already-attached current window. Please make updateNSView refresh the weak workspace/current request closure and report view.window when available, with identity guards remaining in Workspace; add a bounded test seam/reuse regression if possible. Keep this a separate source-only correction, no GUI/build. Native didEndSheet parent observation matches Apple documentation (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appkit/nswindow/didendsheetnotification); actual detach ordering remains for A GUI. A is reviewing the native candidate and has not run it yet; both earlier failures remain. Avoid any timing workaround or broader presentation rewrite.
